messages:
incident-bot: Pager SEV2: kv-cache TTL variance causing repeated cold-start requests for long-prefix chat workloads in us-west-2. Impact: elevated token cost and request latency for ~2% of hosted traffic. Paging oncall @sre-oncall. Links: https://internal.incidents/r/1797654321 :rotating_light:
sre-oncall: On it. Starting livebridge. Maya, can you pull the kvcache eviction logs and recent deploys?
maya: grabbing logs now, will post short excerpt.
maya: ```
EVICT 2026-03-12T02:14:03Z key-prefix=chat:conv:abc ttl=120 -> evicted because backend reported stale TTL=2
EVICT 2026-03-12T02:14:04Z key-prefix=chat:conv:def ttl=118 -> same pattern
```
joel: saw a spike in throughput from a batch job at 02:13, possible noisy neighbor. Rolling a temporary throttle on that job.
sre-oncall: Good call. Applying rate limit on batch-job-prod-3 now. Confirmed reduced evictions after 02:17.
liz-eng: Noted repeated fallback to smaller model variants for affected requests — customers seeing ~200-400ms added tail latency and some >1s. We should capture sample request ids for customer impact analysis.
maya: collected sample request IDs: RW-req-9a7c, RW-req-9a8d, RW-req-9b2f. Pushed to incident page.
ops-bot: Auto-note: temporary throttle applied to batch-job-prod-3 by joel; throttle_id=throt-775.
joel: thumbs up. Leaving throttle in place for 30m while we assess.
sre-oncall: Handover in 15m to Liz. Current mitigation: throttle + kv cache metrics spike subsiding. No customer-facing page yet, but increased latency for some tenants.
alex-pm: Quick customer-impact estimate? Which tiers affected and any revenue-sensitive customers?
liz-eng: Mostly hosted free/users and lower-tier customers. I see a couple mid-market tenants hitting occasional 5xx retries but not persistent. Tagging accounts in the incident doc.
sre-oncall: I'll start the post-incident checklist: create postmortem, assign owner, capture timeline, and action items. Planning to schedule postmortem meeting tomorrow.
maya: root cause hypothesis: recent kv-cache TTL refactor (deploy 02:10) unintentionally set per-prefix TTLs to default 2s for prefixes >128 chars. Repro script below.
maya: ```bash
# repro: run single warm request twice
curl -s -X POST https://api.internal/cache/warm -d '{"prefix":"chat:conv:long..."}'
# inspect TTL
curl -s https://api.internal/cache/status | jq '.prefixes["chat:conv:long..."]'
```
joel: OK. That refactor commit is in staging->prod rollout at 02:08-02:11. Tagging commit hash: b7f9d3a.
alex-pm: Action planning: we need triage tickets with sizing + priority. Propose three action items: 1) Revert/patch TTL refactor (owner: maya) - estimate 1d. 2) Add regression test for per-prefix TTLs + CI gating (owner: joel) - estimate 2d. 3) Customer-impact reconciliation + crediting for affected tenants (owner: liz-eng & support) - estimate 0.5d. Priorities: P0 for patch, P1 for tests, P1 for credits and comms. Tie to quarterly plan: include the regression test in Q2 infra sprint.
liz-eng: I can own customer comms and credits. Will create support runbook and list tenants.
sre-oncall: Creating postmortem doc RW-54321 and tickets RW-2314 (patch), RW-2315 (regressions), RW-2316 (credits).
ops-bot: Ticket created: RW-2314 (patch) assigned to maya, due 2026-03-13.
ops-bot: Ticket created: RW-2315 (regressions) assigned to joel, due 2026-03-15.
ops-bot: Ticket created: RW-2316 (credits/comms) assigned to liz-eng, due 2026-03-13.
alex-pm: Scheduling: 60m postmortem tomorrow 16:00 PT. Invite eng, sre, support, product. If that works for owners please ack.
maya: ack, will be there, will bring timeline and deploy notes.
joel: ack, will bring CI logs and repro cases.
liz-eng: ack, will bring customer list and comm draft.
sre-oncall: handing off monitoring and follow-ups to Liz for the remediation window. I'll update the incident doc with the current mitigation state and timeline.
alex-pm: Great. For prioritization committee: recommend RW-2315 goes into next infra sprint (Q2) as a hard dependency for stability. RW-2314 to be hotfixed immediately.
liz-eng: I'll coordinate credits and postmortem customer comms after patch. 
incident-bot: Resolution note: mitigation stable, no ongoing evictions. Postmortem scheduled, tickets filed. Close in 1hr unless regress. :white_check_mark:
